hypothesis: Process address randomization may interact with binary identity and contribute to the original off TTFT gap. Change only the server launch personality; inspect actual ready-time code maps.
instrumentation: Ready-time /proc snapshot only; no preload, arena, timing events, PMU or Nsight. Client/runner inherit original personality.
validity: Whole guard COMPLETED; all eight HTTP capacity/output/server-exit contracts pass
Parent/client path not wrapped; parent ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE clear; inherit server bit clear and no-aslr bit set
Same-variant repeated no-aslr executable mappings identical; reference checked before HTTP in runs05 and07
Each same-variant inherit pair differs in executable mapping ranges, demonstrating actual randomization contrast
Hashes of binary and runner/helpers remain frozen

analysis.R: maximum absolute difference between two TTFT observations of each binary+mode
analysis.pairs: first four vs last four, each contains all four conditions
analysis.gate: All validity checks pass, both D0>max(R,1ms) and both I>max(2R,2ms). Otherwise unresolved, stop family.
analysis.limits: No equivalence claim; no-ASLR still leaves intra-binary relative layouts, data/physical/GPU locations and timing unconstrained. Gate only supports personality-dependent interaction, not historical root cause or deployment acceptance.

stop: Exactly fixed eight; no warmup, automatic retries or extra samples
First guard/HTTP/personality/map-reference error stops and preserves evidence
Missing/unstable controlled mappings invalidate causal interpretation; do not rerun to obtain matching maps
No numerical tolerance or performance gate relaxation
